name: Orleans-style mid-joint wings
description: A refrigerated marinade, followed by a 200°C single-layer cook.

notes: If using another marinade brand, use its package ratio; no extra salt or honey here.
Preheat evidence: Philips HD9220 manufacturer manual, page 3; food-observation branch: UK FSA cooking guidance, sections 2.1, 4.1 and 8.
variants.label: Thawed mid-joint wings, refrigerated marinade
variants.portion: 500 g thawed raw chicken mid-joint wings; 8–10 per uncrowded batch, skin-side down.
variants.turn: Turn at minute 8. Check from minute 15.
variants.advancePreparation: Refrigerate in marinade for at least 6 hours.

timeline.label: Marinate
timeline.detail: At least 6 hours refrigerated.

timeline.label: Preheat
timeline.detail: 200°C until ready; HD9220 reference about 3 minutes.

timeline.label: Air fry
timeline.detail: 15–20 minutes per batch; turn at minute 8, check from minute 15.

variants.preheatDetail: Select Air Fry, 200°C. On the Philips HD9220, set the timer beyond 3 minutes and wait for the heating light to go off the first time (about 3 minutes); on other machines use their ready signal.
steps: Pat dry; make shallow cuts in thick flesh. Mix marinade powder with water, coat wings, cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours. If already marinated this way, begin with preheating.

Preheat as above. Drain excess marinade and place wings skin-side down in one layer; about 8–10 per batch, with no overlap. Keep remaining raw wings refrigerated; do not pour marinade into the basket.
Air fry at 200°C for 8 minutes, turn, then cook 7 more minutes and start checking.
Continue at 200°C if not ready and recheck; remove finished pieces using clean tongs onto a clean plate.
variants.completion: Probe the thickest meat, avoiding bone: reach 75°C and hold for at least 30 seconds.
variants.withoutThermometer: With a clean knife, cut the thickest part of a larger piece. Check all three: steaming hot inside, no pink raw meat, and clear juices. If any check fails, keep heating in the current phase and recheck. Appearance and time do not measure core temperature; a thermometer is recommended.
variants.deviceNote: Uses a selectable 200°C setting; no above-200°C step.

sources.evidence: Original manufacturer manual, publicly archived: selectable 80–200°C; set timer beyond 3 minutes and wait for the heating light to go off. Hardware/preheat evidence, not another wing cook time.

safetyOverride.text: Probe the thickest meat, avoiding bone: reach 75°C and hold for at least 30 seconds.

name: Braise-then-roast garlic ribs
description: A complete pan-braise followed by a short air-fryer finish; a hob is required.

notes: Soy/oyster sauce, wine and oil weights are this site’s editorial seasoning formulation, not claimed gram conversions from the author’s spoons. No extra salt.
Requires a hob and pan; cannot be completed using only an air fryer. Continuous cooking only, not overnight-rib reheating.
variants.label: Hob-braised first, then air-fried while hot
variants.portion: 500 g thawed pork rib pieces, similarly sized; braise until fully cooked before air frying.
variants.turn: After 3 minutes, turn, add garlic and change to 180°C for 4 minutes.
ingredients: 10 g light soy sauce; 10 g oyster sauce
20 g cooking wine; 5 g cooking oil
Boiling water, enough to just cover ribs in the pan
variants.advancePreparation: Pan-sear and braise fully before the 7-minute air-fry finish.

timeline.label: Sear and braise
timeline.detail: Brown both sides; cover with boiling water, bring back to a simmer and check after 15 minutes. Continue until cooked and tender.

timeline.label: Reduce and preheat
timeline.detail: Reduce to a thin coating of sauce. Preheat air fryer to 200°C; manual reference 5 minutes.

timeline.label: Air-fry finish
timeline.detail: 200°C for 3 minutes, then add garlic and 180°C for 4 minutes per batch.

variants.preheatDetail: Preheat to 200°C while reducing the sauce. Manual preheat reference: 5 minutes, within Hualing MF-KZ01WS manufacturer 3–5 minute guidance; use a ready signal if available.
steps: Remove loose bone fragments and pat dry. Heat the measured oil in a lidded pan; sear ribs on both sides, then add cooking wine.
Add boiling water just to cover, plus soy and oyster sauces. Bring back to a boil, cover and maintain a gentle simmer; check after 15 minutes.
Confirm cooked through using the checks below before tasting tenderness. Keep braising if tough or not ready; top up with boiling water as needed.
Uncover and reduce until ribs carry a thin coating. Preheat the air fryer as described above.
Place still-hot, fully cooked ribs in one layer, leaving liquid in the pan. Air fry at 200°C for 3 minutes.
Turn, scatter garlic and reduce to 180°C for 4 minutes. Transfer with clean tongs.
variants.completion: During braising, probe thick meat away from bone: reach 75°C for at least 30 seconds. Only then proceed to the air-fry finish.
variants.withoutThermometer: With a clean knife, cut the thickest part of a larger piece. Check all three: steaming hot inside, no pink raw meat, and clear juices. If any check fails, keep heating in the current phase and recheck. Appearance and time do not measure core temperature; a thermometer is recommended.
variants.deviceNote: Requires selectable 200°C and 180°C settings. The 7-minute finish is only for freshly braised, still-hot ribs.

sources.evidence: Manufacturer suggests 3–5 minutes preheat and shows 180°C and 200°C dial markings. This guide uses 5 minutes within that range; not evidence for a raw-rib cooking clock.

safetyOverride.text: Confirm fully cooked in the braising phase: thick meat away from bone reaches 75°C for at least 30 seconds.

name: Frozen thin fries, cold start
description: A 180°C cold-start reference with the fry size and product type specified.

notes: Use pre-fried thin fries, not raw potatoes, wedges or thick-cut fries.
The 200 g example is within the manual’s range; the reminder schedule is an editorial aid, not a weight-to-time formula.
variants.label: Frozen pre-fried thin fries, 7 mm wide
variants.portion: 200 g frozen pre-fried fries, about 7 × 7 mm; do not thaw or add oil.
variants.turn: Shake about 5, 10 and 15 minutes after starting.
ingredients: 200 g frozen pre-fried thin fries, about 7 × 7 mm
variants.preheatDetail: No preheat: this is the Philips HD9200 cold-start method. If your product provides air-fryer directions, follow that complete method instead.
steps: Fit the basket and crisper insert; add 200 g frozen fries, shake apart and stay below the maximum line.
Start Air Fry at 180°C and set an initial 16-minute reminder.
At about minutes 5, 10 and 15, pull out and shake or turn with tongs. These are elapsed times, not a new 16-minute cycle each time.
At minute 16, take one out, cool briefly and break it open. It should be hot and soft inside without a hard frozen center, and golden outside.
If not ready or if more crispness is wanted, continue at 180°C and recheck using short reminders (for example 2 minutes). Do not aim for dark brown or burnt fries.
variants.completion: Hot, soft center with no cold hard core, and a golden exterior; the 16–23 minute range is not a command to cook every batch for 23 minutes.
variants.deviceNote: Philips HD9200 reference, cold start, 180°C. Follow stricter product directions as a complete method; do not silently lower above-200°C package instructions.

name: Whole roasted sweet potato
description: Wash and roast whole without oil. Preheat to 200°C and start checking the center after 40 minutes.

notes: This follows the author’s preheated 200°C method, not the cold-start settings of the Philips HD9257.

The independent HD9257 reference uses 6–9 medium sweet potatoes at 180°C for 35 minutes without preheating, with piercing and turning. Load, temperature, appliance and starting conditions differ; the settings were not averaged.
The doneness check and short-interval rechecks are editorial handling advice. This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.
variants.label: 1 sweet potato that fits flat in the basket
variants.portion: 1 sweet potato that fits flat in the basket

steps: Scrub the sweet potato and leave it whole. Assemble the basket and preheat to 200°C.
Place it in the basket and air fry at 200°C for 40 minutes.
Using heat-resistant gloves, pull out the basket. Pierce the thickest part with a skewer or chopstick. If the center is firm, continue at 200°C and check in short intervals.
Once soft through the center, remove with tongs and let cool slightly before splitting.

timeline.label: Wash
timeline.detail: Scrub off soil and rinse the skin.

timeline.label: Preheat
timeline.detail: 200°C, until the appliance is ready.

timeline.label: Air fry
timeline.detail: 200°C; start checking at 40 minutes.

variants.preheatDetail: Preheat to 200°C until the appliance is ready. The main source gives no separate preheat duration.
variants.completion: A skewer passes through the thickest part and the opened center is soft, with no firm core. Continue cooking if it is still firm at 40 minutes.
variants.deviceNote: The main source names no model or weight. Treat 40 minutes as a checkpoint; a thicker sweet potato can need longer.

description: Slice cooked mantou about 1 cm thick, brush with oil and season. Cook 8 minutes on the first side, then turn and cook 5 minutes.

The independent comparison uses thinner slices coated in egg: preheat to 180°C, cook 4 minutes, turn and cook 2 minutes. Coating, thickness and method differ, so its 6-minute time is not used here.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

variants.portion: 2 cooked mantou; one non-overlapping layer per batch

Arrange in a single layer without overlapping; work in batches if needed. Brush the top lightly with oil and add some seasoning.
Cook at 180°C for 8 minutes, then turn. Brush and season the other side and cook at 180°C for 5 more minutes.
Check for a dry surface and crisp edges. Remove when the texture suits you, before any blackening.

variants.completion: Both surfaces are dry and fragrant, edges crisp and the center hot. Avoid blackening.
variants.advancePreparation: Use fully cooked, cooled mantou, not raw dough.

name: Egg tarts with homemade custard
description: Use large ready-made tart shells and mix your own cream custard. Preheat the first batch at 180°C for 3 minutes; check each batch after 12 minutes.

notes: The full 15-large-tart formula is retained; quantities were not calculated from an assumed shell volume.

The independent comparison uses 8 shells, 125 ml sweetened milk and 2 eggs without cream, cooking at 180°C for 20 minutes. Its different liquid proportions, preheat and turning step at 15 minutes are not combined with this method.
The finish check and storage notes are editorial handling advice. This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

variants.portion: Recipe for 15 large tart shells; keep flat and cook in batches to fit your basket

sources.evidence: 15个大号挞皮；牛奶170ml、淡奶油150ml、蛋3个130g、糖36g、炼乳20g；首批180°C预热3分钟，每批180°C 12分钟，连续第二批免预热。已打开全文。

steps: Mix the milk, sugar and eggs until the sugar disperses. Stir in the condensed milk and cream.
Separate the frozen tart shells; the main source does not wait for them to thaw fully. Preheat the first batch at 180°C for 3 minutes.
Fill each shell about six-tenths full, place flat in the basket, then top up to eight- or nine-tenths full to avoid spilling while moving. Work in batches.
Cook at 180°C and start checking at 12 minutes. Remove when the center is set without flowing raw custard and the pastry is cooked and crisp. If still liquid, continue at 180°C and recheck.
For an immediately following batch, skip another preheat and again check after 12 minutes at 180°C. Store uncooked custard and shells chilled or frozen as appropriate to their packaging.
ingredients: 3 eggs, about 130 g in the original recipe

timeline.detail: Combine milk, eggs and sugar, then add cream and condensed milk.

variants.deviceNote: Shell size and basket design affect progress. Twelve minutes is a checkpoint, not a guarantee for every appliance.

name: Eggplant with pan-cooked garlic sauce
description: Roast the eggplant until soft, then briefly cook with pan-fried garlic sauce. Requires both a hob and an air fryer.

notes: Oil 15 g, radish 10 g, soy sauce 10 g, 1 chili, 1 spring onion and cumin 0.5 g are editorial seasoning amounts, not conversions of the author’s spoons or unspecified amounts. The eggplant and whole head of garlic follow the main source.
The main method uses 200°C for 20 minutes, 5 more minutes to soften, then 1–2 minutes with sauce. The 26–27 minutes count only air frying, excluding preparation and pan work.

The independent Lan Fan comparison uses 2 long eggplants at 170°C for 25 minutes, then 160°C for 5 minutes, and pours hot oil over its garlic mixture. Different sauce methods and temperatures were not averaged.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

variants.portion: 1 eggplant, cut into two sections that fit flat in the basket

sources.publisher: 好爱喝乌龙茶 / 下厨房

steps: Wash and cut the eggplant into two sections. Brush lightly with oil and air fry at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning partway through.
Meanwhile, heat some oil in a frying pan over medium-low heat. Add garlic, optional chili and radish. Once fragrant, mix in soy sauce; do not blacken the garlic.
Slit open the cooked eggplant and spread the flesh with chopsticks. Brush lightly with a little oil and cook at 200°C for 5 minutes.
Check that the flesh is soft. If still firm, keep cooking until soft before adding the sauce.
Spread with the garlic sauce. Check after 1 minute at 200°C; the reference finish is 1–2 minutes. Remove before the garlic scorches, then add cumin and spring onion.

15 g cooking oil, divided between brushing and frying

name: Cumin-chili shiitake mushrooms
description: Toss fresh shiitake in spices and let stand briefly. Preheat to 180°C, cook 10 minutes, turn and cook 8 minutes more.

notes: Although the author defines tablespoon as 15 ml and teaspoon as 5 ml, this recipe uses a separate editorial weighing plan: oil 10 g, soy sauce 10 g, cumin 2 g, chili 1 g, garlic 1 g, five-spice 0.5 g, pepper 0.5 g, salt 1 g and sugar 3 g. The independent HD9257 table uses about 800 g cauliflower and mushrooms at 180°C for 10 minutes, cold-started, cut up and tossed with 1 tablespoon oil, with turning. This is a general mushroom-and-vegetable table, not a repeat validation of this exact shiitake recipe. No load conversion or transfer of its cold-start rule was made.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

sources.title: 空气炸锅烤香菇 / Air Fryer Roasted Mushrooms
sources.locator: 作者视频说明：材料及做法1–6
sources.evidence: 12朵鲜香菇约285g；去蒂划花、沥干拌自调烧烤酱、腌片刻；预热后180°C 10分钟，翻面再8分钟。已下载原始视频页并读取作者完整中英文说明。

sources.title: HD9257 用户手册
sources.locator: PDF第2页：蔬菜预设一行及空气煎炸说明
sources.evidence: 800g花菜、菇类等；洗净切块拌1汤匙油，180°C 10分钟，翻动。本机无需预热。独立对照是菇类基础表，非同配方重复。已渲染核对。

steps: Remove tough stems. Optionally score the caps shallowly, then wash and drain.
Mix oil, soy sauce and all seasonings. Toss the mushrooms to coat and let stand briefly while the fryer preheats to 180°C.
Arrange in one layer, gills up and caps down. Brush the surface lightly with a little oil and cook at 180°C for 10 minutes.
Turn, brush the other side lightly and continue at 180°C for 8 minutes.
Remove when soft throughout and hot through the thickest parts. If still firm or cool inside, continue at 180°C and recheck.
ingredients: 10 g corn oil, plus a little for brushing

timeline.label: Prepare and coat
timeline.detail: Remove tough stems, score the caps, wash, drain and coat.

timeline.label: Brief marinade and preheat
timeline.detail: Let the coated mushrooms stand briefly while preheating to 180°C.

timeline.label: Air fry
timeline.detail: 180°C for 10 minutes, then turn and cook 8 more minutes.

variants.preheatDetail: The main source uses a preheated air fryer. Preheat to 180°C until ready; no unsupported preheat duration has been added.
variants.completion: The mushrooms are soft throughout and hot through thick areas without raw, firm sections; edges are dry and fragrant rather than black.
variants.advancePreparation: Let the seasoned fresh mushrooms stand briefly. The author specifies only a short rest, so no fixed marinating duration has been imposed.

name: Boiled-then-roasted corn
description: Boil the corn until cooked, then roast at 200°C for 20 minutes, rotating several times. Requires both a saucepan and an air fryer.

notes: One or two ears is an editorial single-layer portion; the main source specifies no count. Fifteen minutes is treated as the first boiling check, and corn must be cooked before air frying.

The independent sding1126 comparison uses 3 fresh ears with milk, honey and foil, cooking at 200°C for 10 minutes, then turning and cooking 8 minutes. It lists no boiling step. This recipe follows the main source’s precooked, unseasoned, uncovered method; food state and time are not treated as interchangeable.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.
variants.label: 1–2 ears of corn that fit in one layer; an editorial small-batch choice
variants.portion: 1–2 ears of corn that fit in one layer; an editorial small-batch choice
variants.turn: Rotate several times during cooking so the cylindrical cobs heat on all sides. The source gives no fixed rotating minutes.

sources.title: 「空气炸锅真是伟大的发明」
sources.evidence: 玉米先在开水中煮15分钟或蒸15分钟；熟玉米直接200°C烤20分钟，中途多转几面，无调味。已下载原始公开HTML并读取该完整章节。

sources.title: 空气炸锅 烤玉米
sources.evidence: 新鲜玉米3根，刷牛奶蜂蜜、撒孜然黑胡椒；200°C先10分钟，翻面再8分钟，可打开锡纸继续烤；没有写先煮步骤。与主参考先煮熟、无酱、20分钟的方法不同，不将18分钟视为生熟等价。已打开全文。

steps: Remove husks and silk and wash the corn. Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, add the corn and start checking after 15 minutes of boiling. Continue until the kernels are cooked and tender.
Lift out and drain surface water, then put straight into the basket. Cut into sections if too long, and arrange in one layer.
Air fry at 200°C for 20 minutes, rotating with tongs several times so all sides face the heat.
Remove when lightly roasted outside and hot and tender inside. Take it out sooner if it has reached the texture you want; do not aim for blackening.
ingredients: Enough water to cover the corn in the saucepan

timeline.label: Boil first
timeline.detail: Start checking after 15 minutes in boiling water; continue until cooked.

timeline.label: Drain
timeline.detail: Drain surface water. Do not add sauce.

timeline.label: Air fry
timeline.detail: 200°C for 20 minutes, rotating several times.

variants.preheatDetail: The main source puts cooked corn straight into the air fryer without listing a separate preheat.
variants.completion: The corn must be cooked before air frying. At serving it is hot through and tender with a lightly roasted surface, without blackening.
variants.advancePreparation: Boil fully, then proceed directly to air frying. This 20-minute stage is not for raw corn and is not a reheating guide for corn stored overnight.
